about.background:
DE DON DC Facility Management And Cleaning Services is a Nigerian company established in November 2022, providing professional cleaning, fumigation, pest control and facility maintenance solutions for residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, educational and industrial environments.

Led by a professional with previous cleaning and facilities-related experience in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), we are committed to delivering dependable services through appropriate cleaning methods, attention to detail, responsible chemical handling and professional customer service.
about.mission: To deliver dependable, quality-focused cleaning and facility management solutions that promote cleanliness, hygiene, safety and comfort for our clients.
about.vision: To become a trusted cleaning and facility management service provider recognised for professionalism, reliability, customer satisfaction and consistent service quality in Nigeria and international markets.
